business_scope.primary_industry_name: Leveraged Buyout Acquisition Syndicate and Special Purpose Co

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF creation), Law 1121 of 2006, Single Regulatory Decree 1068 of 2015, Financial Superintendency External Circular 029 of 2014, and Superintendency of Companies Resolution 2020100006235 of 2020 on UBO identification and registration.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Legal Existence and Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal)
Notarized Charter and Bylaws of the Foreign Ultimate Parent / PE Fund Manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public Notary in Country of Origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney Appointing the Colombian Legal Representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public Notary in Country of Origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Affidavit and Ultimate Beneficial Owner Identification Form

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of national and foreign Persons Exposed Politically (PEPs), UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, and domestic Colombian sanctions lists (UIAF and Superintendency of Companies). Enhanced due diligence applied to private equity buyout SPVs under SFC External Circular 029 of 2014.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be submitted in Spanish or in a Latin-script transliteration. The business name must include the suffix 'S.A.S.' and must follow Cámara de Comercio naming conventions, avoiding identical or confusingly similar names in any Colombian registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the interested party may file a written reconsideration request before the same Cámara de Comercio within ten business days of notification. If the rejection is maintained, an administrative appeal may be filed before the Superintendency of Companies under the General Administrative Procedure Code (Law 1437 of 2011).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is generally permissible for an S.A.S. provided a precise physical domicile is registered for receipt of legal notifications and the registered address is not solely a mail-forwarding service for the private equity SPV without additional local substance evidence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium (approximately 25% annual probability for a private equity buyout SPV classified under medium-risk enhanced AML/CFT supervision), rising sharply upon any red-flag transaction, PEP linkage, or sanction screening hit.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official name reservation request at Cámara de Comercio
S.A.S. incorporation and registration with the Chamber of Commerce
Notarized private incorporation instrument and book registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public and Cámara de Comercio
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff and statutory commercial registry fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and national sanctions screening database access
Apostille/legalization of foreign corporate documents and UBO declarations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Colombia and notarial authorities

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting of corporate bylaws, SPV governance, and compliance manual

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), arts. 2, 4, 5, 24; Código de Comercio, arts. 110, 111, 142; Decreto 2042 de 2014 (registry procedure)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá), under oversight of Superintendencia de Sociedades
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal / Matrícula Mercantil, filed through the Registro Único Empresarial (RUE)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; S.A.S. may be incorporated with zero paid-in capital. No escrow account is mandatorily required, but shareholders must define the subscription payment terms in the bylaws.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) Share Capital — The shareholders approve the share subscription and allotment as detailed in the Subscription Schedule, and confirm payment of the subscribed quota. (2) Registered Office — The company adopts the domicile stated in the bylaws as its statutory seat, and the legal representative is authorized to execute lease agreements and administrative filings. (3) Officers — The shareholders appoint the President, Vice-President (optional), and Fiscal Auditor (where legally required), with full powers to represent the company, open bank accounts, hire employees, and execute the corporate registration before the Chamber of Commerce. These resolutions take immediate effect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name availability check and reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal (online portal: RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed names to the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES); the chamber verifies absence of identical or confusingly similar existing registrations and reserves the approved name for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Shareholder identification documents or passport copies
Power of attorney for designated incorporator, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected on grounds of similarity, submit up to three alternative names and reapply immediately; no additional fee applies if filed within the same application window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the private incorporation document and bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public or Cámara de Comercio according to jurisdictional rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución containing bylaws, share capital subscription, and appointment of administrators. If in-kind contributions exceed the legal threshold, the document must be elevated to a public deed before a notary. All shareholders sign and authenticate.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney if a representative signs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or chamber finds omissions, cure by executing an amendment to the incorporation document; no resubmission fee beyond the notary charge if completed within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registry registration and issuance of the legal existence certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal (RUES office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the full incorporation document, completed Form RUE, and evidence of payment of registry fees. The chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal after verifying compliance; this certificate evidences legal existence and legal representative authority.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry files an official query (nota devolutiva), the party must correct the specified defect and resubmit; response must occur within 10 business days to avoid cancellation. A re-file fee applies only for new submissions after the response window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax identification (NIT) and RUT registration with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN — Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (online: www.dian.gov.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Número de Identificación Tributaria by completing the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) using the incorporation certificate and legal representative data. After obtaining the RUT, open the corporate bank account and notify tax authorities of the active address.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Copy of the board resolution authorizing the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT application for inconsistency in legal representation, provide the updated certificate from the Chamber of Commerce and reapply; a virtual appointment with DIAN may be scheduled to resolve errors in 48 hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate books, officer formalization, and post-registration compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio / Superintendencia de Sociedades
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Record the corporate minutes and share subscription ledger in the RUE system, formalize officer positions in the company's record, and file any required social security and occupational risk registration for officers and employees.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (updated)
Appointment documentation for President, Secretary, and Fiscal Auditor (where applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the corporate books are not accepted due to formal defects, correct by redoing the affected folios and paying a substitution fee; the chamber will provide a conditional acceptance within 5 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for ISIC 6499 (financial services SPV). No industrial licensing board is required; if the SPV were to hold regulated financial assets, Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia would be the supervisory authority.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating license is mandated. A financial holding SPV may require prior authorization from Superintendencia Financiera only if it intends to manage third-party funds or execute regulated private-equity syndication activity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Agencia Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) — applicable only if the SPV creates physical contamination sources; otherwise no EIA is submitted
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — administrative and office-based financial services are not listed in Annex I of Resolution 1287 of 2021; Category 3 (no significant environmental impact)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office operations must comply with municipal wastewater discharge standards (Resolución 0631 de 2015) and ambient air quality parameters (Resolución 2254 de 2017). No VOC limits apply unless vehicle maintenance or industrial equipment is introduced to the premises.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety permit from the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos; structural load inspection and occupancy clearance from the municipal planning office; mandatory occupational risk insurance (ARL) and workplace coexistence agreement for all employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — National Tax and Customs Directorate; operational portal: MUISCA (https://www.muisca.dian.gov.co); institutional portal: https://www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate the S.A.S. by notarial deed or private document under Law 1258/2008; non-resident shareholders must deliver apostilled corporate resolutions and appoint a legal representative domiciled in Colombia. 2) Register the company with the Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce), obtaining the commercial registration and a pre-RUT. 3) Using the pre-RUT credentials, complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) application on DIAN's MUISCA portal, electing tax responsibilities: corporate income tax, VAT (IVA) if applicable, withholding duties, and any other statutory obligations. 4) The legal representative or authorized accountant certifies the RUT with a valid digital certificate; DIAN assigns the definitive NIT. 5) The company then activates electronic invoicing authorization, the foreign-exchange channel (Declaración de Cambio) through a local bank, and any sectoral municipal registrations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: S.A.S. is a standalone juridical taxpayer under Art. 12 of the Tax Statute; resident by incorporation and principal office; taxed on worldwide income at the 35% corporate income tax rate (2025). No pass-through or fiscally transparent status is available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box: entity-level taxation is mandatory for all S.A.S. Statutory elections available: (i) election to consolidate affiliated entities as a single VAT taxpayer under Art. 53 E.T.; (ii) opt-in to the SIMPLE regime where turnover and wealth thresholds are met; (iii) accelerated depreciation of 20% per annum for eligible productive capital goods; (iv) optional protective treaty positions before DIAN for CFC/hybrid mismatch exposures, as the anti-avoidance rules themselves are non-elective.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover de minimis for entities: VAT responsibility arises on the first taxable supply in Colombia or first import. The optional Monotributo formalization applies below 3,500 UVT (COP 174,296,500 in 2025); non-resident digital-service suppliers must register where prior-year Colombian consumer receipts exceed 40,000 UVT, except under platform-based simplified collection regimes imposed by DIAN decree without a minimum threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (factura electrónica de venta) with DIAN pre-validation: invoices must be issued through DIAN-authorized invoicing software and transmitted in real time to MUISCA via web-services API (SOAP/REST), receiving a unique CUFE/CUDE code before delivery to the buyer; export invoices must be validated before submission of the export customs declaration. Software providers require DIAN authorization; failure to comply invalidates the invoice for input-VAT credits and deductions and triggers monetary penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported from Colombian customs territory qualify for 0% VAT with full input-VAT recovery (Art. 481 E.T.). Export services, including software development and BPO/call-center services performed in Colombia for non-resident recipients, qualify when the service is economically 'exported', used abroad, and the corresponding proceeds enter Colombia through the foreign-exchange channel. A PE buyout SPV holding passive equity investments will normally generate no export turnover; management-fee and acquisition services are outside the VAT taxable scope or constitute VAT-exempt/denied inputs.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic export declaration (DEX/SIEX filing approved by DIAN customs)
Original commercial invoice / export invoice (factura de exportación) pre-validated by DIAN with CUFE
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing exit from Colombian customs territory
Bank inward-remittance certificate / foreign-exchange channel declaration (Formulario de Declaración de Cambio)
Certificate of origin and any sector-specific permits where required
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may audit export refunds within the general 5-year review term (Art. 705 E.T.). False exports, inflated refunds, or unrepatriated proceeds attract: (i) the 200% inexactness penalty on the excess refund claimed (Art. 647 E.T.); (ii) compulsory reversal with default interest; (iii) criminal tax fraud sanctions under Law 2277/2022, including imprisonment up to 9 years and disqualification of the legal representative; and (iv) removal of the exporter from the DIAN registered-exporters list with consequential blacklisting of the NIT.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Banrep) as the central bank and foreign exchange authority, acting jointly with the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit and the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia in administering the exchange control regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian Peso (COP) is convertible for current-account transactions (trade in goods, services, and ordinary remittances) subject to submission of a foreign-exchange declaration through an authorized intermediary within the statutory deadlines. Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment (FDI) and outward investment, are fully convertible only after prior registration with Banco de la República and after channeling funds through the official foreign-exchange market. Dividends and capital repatriation can be remitted abroad without further FX approval if the investment was duly registered and tax obligations have been settled; the remittance of earnings is subject to the withholding and remittance tax under the Colombian Income Tax.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Decree 1198 of 2016 and External Regulation No. 1 of 2018, exporters of goods must channel export proceeds into the foreign-exchange market and surrencer the equivalent of 100% of the collectable export amount within 6 months from the date of the export customs declaration. For services exports, the surrender period is 6 months from the accrual date. The conversion to COP is mandatory unless the exporter is eligible for an exemption (e.g., free-zone status, certain technological services with special regimes). Foreign-exchange intermediaries must receive the proceeds in a foreign currency account or exchange them directly and file the corresponding foreign-exchange declaration.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Offshore fintech EMIs (Wise, Revolut, Airwallex, etc.) do not hold any banking or financial license from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia and are not authorized to open local corporate accounts or to act as local foreign-exchange intermediaries. Their use may cause violations of the Colombian FX channeling rules and expose the SPV to unauthorized intermediation. A locally licensed commercial bank or a licensed branch of a foreign bank (e.g., Citibank Colombia) is required for compliant treasury operations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a foreign-owned S.A.S. SPV, account opening requires substantial due diligence. Physical presence of the legal representative or a locally appointed agent with power of attorney is virtually mandatory for the initial onboarding interview, in particular for high-risk sectors or when the beneficial owner is non-resident. Some banks allow a hybrid procedure (video conference plus notarized/legalized documents) for low-risk structures, but this is at the bank's sole discretion and usually still requires a local contact for compliance communications. We strongly recommend appointing a resident legal or tax attorney with valid power of attorney and a physical local office address.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) structure, e.g., a trust or holding in a secrecy jurisdiction preventing identification of natural persons holding ≥10%.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Organisational chart identifying all UBOs and their controlling percentages; certified articles of incorporation of each SPV and fund entity; registry extract from the Colombian Chamber of Commerce for the local S.A.S.; sworn declaration and source-of-funds statement from the fund's AML officer; apostilled passports and utility bills of all UBOs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership with minimal physical substance, indicating potential shell or conduit entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan and investment memorandum evidencing the private-equity buyout mandate; executed acquisition agreement or letter of intent; audited financial statements of the fund and the SPV (if any); evidence of a genuine local registered address and active Colombian legal representation; client profile questionnaire (CPQ) completed by the fund's compliance department.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Involvement of a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) in the ownership or signatory structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence report approved by the parent fund's AML committee; certification that the PEP's funds originated from a regulated financial institution; declaration that no Colombian public funds are involved; additional background check and legal opinion from a Colombian law firm.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection significantly exceeds transaction value or originates from an unregulated exchange or crypto service.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized source-of-wealth letter; 12-month bank statements of the funding account; share purchase agreement and funding schedule from the fund's LP (limited partner); audited annual report of the investor; confirmation that the funding route complies with Colombian FX and AML rules, including the use of an authorized intermediary.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All capital injections into the Colombian S.A.S. must be routed through an authorized foreign-exchange intermediary (the local commercial bank) using SWIFT MT103. Prior to the transfer, the foreign investment must be registered with Banco de la República via the 'Formulario de Inversión Internacional' and assigned a Caribbean Clearing House (CCH) Code or an internal foreign investment code. The wire reference field must include the NIT (tax identification number) of the S.A.S. and the registration number assigned by Banco de la República, and must indicate the transaction purpose as 'Foreign Direct Investment – Equity Contribution'. The receiving bank will prepare the corresponding Declaración de Cambio and issue an impresión of the foreign investment registration, which constitutes legal proof of the capital inflow for future profit remittance and capital repatriation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For syndicated-loan disbursements and acquisition payments abroad, the S.A.S. must instruct its local bank via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for interbank transfers) with the standard commercial description and the relevant outward foreign-exchange declaration. Payments for the acquisition of shares or assets in a foreign target are classified as outward investment and require prior registration with Banco de la República if the investment exceeds the applicable de minimis threshold (currently equivalent to USD 100,000.00 as updated by external regulation). Where the counterparty requires a payment guarantee, a Commercial Letter of Credit (L/C) at sight or usance may be opened through the local bank's trade desk, subject to underlying transaction documentation. The L/C must comply with Colombian tax withholding rules and be reported in the FX declaration if the intended settlement is in foreign currency.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable Foreign Exchange Forward (DF) between the S.A.S. and a Colombian authorized bank, with mandatory delivery of COP against USD at maturity.
Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) settled in USD, permissible when the underlying exposure relates to a future liability denominated in COP that cannot be fully covered by an onshore deliverable forward.
Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swap (CCIRS) between USD and COP, used to hedge both currency and interest-rate risk on long-term acquisition financing.
Foreign Exchange Options (spot and OTC call/put) on USD/COP, provided the contract is linked to a genuine commercial or investment operation and is documented in the files of the local intermediary.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of commercial registration ('renovación de la matrícula mercantil') and updated business data declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered seat, integrated into the Single Business and Social Registry (RUES)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of each calendar year; renewal reflects the company's asset position as of 31 December of the immediately preceding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal accrues default interest on the renewal tariff and may incur administrative fines by the Cámara de Comercio; the company is blocked from obtaining a clean 'certificado de existencia y representación legal', preventing bank closings and notarial acts; failure to renew for five consecutive years may lead to administrative cancellation of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO confirmation ('actualización anual del Registro de Beneficiarios Finales') and disclosure of qualifying share quota transfers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) through the electronic Beneficiarios Finales web service
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed each calendar year between 1 March and 30 April, reflecting the ownership chain as of 31 December of the prior year; any transfer of quotas or shares representing 5% or more of the capital or control is additionally reported within 30 days of the transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted filing exposes the legal representative and the company to fines under the Colombian Tax Code, compromises issuance of tax standing certificates, restricts access to electronic invoice and clearance services, and may be treated as a violation of the shareholder confirmation duty in syndicated loan covenants.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual general-purpose financial statements, management report and, if applicable, revisor fiscal report deposited in the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' meeting and subsequent deposit with the Cámara de Comercio of the registered office in the RUES
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For each fiscal year ending 31 December: the financial statements and management report must be prepared within three months and submitted to the annual shareholders' meeting no later than 31 March; the approved statements and any revisor fiscal report are deposited with the Cámara de Comercio within one month after approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-preparation or non-deposit of the statutory financial statements constitutes an administrative offense under Law 222 of 1995; the Superintendencia de Sociedades may impose fines and the company cannot renew the matrícula mercantil until the deposit obligation is remedied.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Colombian SAS must appoint a statutory auditor (revisor fiscal) when any of the following is met at 31 December of the immediately preceding fiscal year: (i) total assets equal or exceed 5,000 SMMLV (statutory monthly minimum wages); (ii) gross income equals or exceeds 3,000 SMMLV; (iii) the company has 200 or more employees; or (iv) the SAS is expressly required by its articles, shareholder agreement, syndicated loan covenants or a supervisory regulation. This private-equity buyout SPV will therefore require a revisor fiscal only if the statutory thresholds are crossed or if lenders impose independent audit as a condition precedent.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Financial statements must be prepared in accordance with Colombian NIIF (IFRS) rules issued under Decree 2420/2015 and its amendments. A closed SAS in this SPV structure generally qualifies as a Group 2 entity and applies 'NIIF para Pymes' (IFRS for SMEs); if it is consolidated into a larger private equity group or breaches certain size thresholds, full IFRS may apply.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The annual confirmation is filed electronically with DIAN through the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales, covering all natural persons holding directly or indirectly 5% or more of the quotas, shares or voting rights, or exercising control through other means. The protocol requires the legal representative to verify the chain through each intermediate holding company; any share quota transfer, new issuance, or change in ultimate control during the year triggers a separate supplementary report within 30 days, and the next annual filing must reflect the updated ownership structure as of 31 December.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (libro de registro de accionistas)
Register of Directors (libro de registro de la junta directiva)
Minute Book (libro de actas de asamblea general)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$350 - US$1,500 per year for a commercial registered office and agent in Bogotá or Medellín
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,500 - US$9,500 per year for a compact private-equity SPV audit or review, increasing with consolidation complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (standard national corporate income tax rate under Law 2277 of 2022 for tax years 2022 through 2025; no incremental hydrocarbon or energy surcharge applies to a private equity buyout SPV incorporated as a Colombian S.A.S.).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No automatic tax holiday applies. Preferential items available to the SPV: (i) 100% additional first-year depreciation for new productive fixed assets acquired in 2023-2025; (ii) 50% tax deduction for investments in qualified science, technology and innovation projects; (iii) 25% tax credit for investments in film and orange-economy activities; (iv) exemption for dividends received from Colombian operating subsidiaries when the underlying profits have already borne the 35% CIT; (v) reduced occasional-gain (capital gains) cédula treatment on sale of qualifying shares rather than the 35% ordinary rate; (vi) foreign tax credit for foreign-source income included in the worldwide base.
